subject: english
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

You will get a discount on this products, if you buy one more outfit.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**on this products, if**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is in the phrase "**on this products,if**"
 
• The correct phrasing should be "**on this product**."
 
• The error is in the use of the word "**products**," which is plural, but the sentence is referring to a single item or product, so it should be in the singular form, "**product**."
 
• "**This**" is a singular demonstrative pronoun, which indicates a single item or thing.
 
• The corrected sentence: "*You will get a discount on this product if you buy one more outfit.*"
 
• In this corrected sentence, **"product" is singular**, matching the intended meaning of the sentence, which is to offer a discount on a single item or product when a customer buys one more outfit.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
